subject: Scope change: one person-chosen state, voice playbook onboarding (D-coord-011, D-coord-012)
body: Product owner direction. MVP = one state the person chooses and describes in their own words, elicited by voice with docs/hackathon/elicitation-playbook.md: strategy order, then submodalities per step, then drivers by contrast, then recode, test and future pace. Three emotions is the next version, so shapes hold 1 to 3 states. A strategy is an ordered list of steps (modality, internal/external, content, submodalities); anchors are step detail; physiology/focus/language is a derived view. Your branch was merged to main: restart from it (git fetch && git checkout -B lane/<id> origin/main), revise PLAN.md, and supersede decisions that assume three emotions or fixed triad order.
